'''Wolfgang Kautek''' is an Austrian physical chemist and the head of the [[Physical chemistry]] department at the [[University of Vienna]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Institut für Physikalische Chemie |url=https://pchem.univie.ac.at/ |access-date=2025-05-15 |website=pchem.univie.ac.at |language=de}}</ref>

He is the President of the [[Erwin Schrödinger Society for Nanosciences]] (ESG)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Erwin Schrödinger Society for Nanosciences |url=http://www.esg-nano.ac.at/page.php?lang=de&content=management |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304061557/http://www.esg-nano.ac.at/page.php?lang=de&content=management |archive-date=4 March 2016 |access-date=2025-05-15 |website=www.esg-nano.ac.at |url-status=live }}</ref> and the Chairman of the Research Group "Physical Chemistry" at the [[Austrian Chemical Society]] (GÖCh).<ref>{{Cite web |title=GÖCH - Arbeitsgruppen |url=http://www.goech.at/arbeitsgruppen.shtml |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190424115644/http://www.goech.at/arbeitsgruppen.shtml |archive-date=24 April 2019 |access-date=2025-05-15 |website=www.goech.at |url-status=live }}</ref>
